name: Name
codeTip: The app shows a new six digit code every 30 seconds. Without your phone, one of your recovery codes works too.
badCode: The code does not match. Take a fresh one from the app or a recovery code.
logCodeTip: The code is in the log of the CannonCommander container: on Unraid in the Docker tab, click the icon, then Logs. It works for 10 minutes. The reset signs out every other session and takes away your API tokens, passkeys and two-factor authentication.

short.one: The new password needs at least {n} character.
short.other: The new password needs at least {n} characters.

resetRejected: The code is wrong or has run out. If it ran out, the log shows a new one now.
failed: That didn't work. Please try again.
resetDone: Your new password is set, and every other session has ended.
resetServices: Sign-in services stay paused until a test sign-in works again.
bye: You are signed out. See you soon!
again: Your session ran out. Please sign in again.

needsPassword.title: This needs a password first
needsPassword.reason: Set a password of your own above. It always gets you in, even when another way fails.

notLocal.title: This comes from your sign-in service
notLocal.reason: You sign in through {name}. Set up two-factor authentication and passkeys there.

password.hint: A password needs at least {min} characters. Changing it ends every other session.
password.openHint: Until a password is set, CannonCommander is open, and everyone who reaches it is an admin.
password.viaService: You sign in through {name}, so this account has no password here.
password.saved: Password saved. Every other session has ended.
password.first: Password set. From here on CannonCommander asks for it
password.removeText: Without a password CannonCommander opens for anyone who reaches its address. These go with it:
password.removed: Password removed. CannonCommander opens without signing in

askPassword.title: Asking for the password
askPassword.hint: Some changes need a sign-in from the last few minutes: new passkeys, API tokens and MCP keys, two-factor authentication, sign-in services, and a password you set for someone else. If yours is older, CannonCommander asks for your password first. With the question off, you sign out and back in instead.
askPassword.label: Ask for the password again
askPassword.on: CannonCommander asks for your password before sensitive changes.
askPassword.off: The question is off. Sensitive changes need a fresh sign-in.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.hint: After the password CannonCommander also asks for a code from an app on your phone.
twoFactor.scan: Scan the code with your authenticator app, then enter the six digits it shows.
twoFactor.sixDigits: Enter the six digits from the app
twoFactor.codesText: Each code signs you in once if your phone is missing. You only see them now, so keep them somewhere safe, in your password manager for example.
twoFactor.newCodesReady: The new codes work, the old ones no longer do
twoFactor.offText: Enter a code from your app or one of your recovery codes. After that the password alone signs you in.
twoFactor.turnedOff: Two-factor authentication is off. The password alone signs you in now

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: A passkey signs you in with your fingerprint, your face or your device's PIN. Your password keeps working.
passkeys.noneHint: Add one and you sign in here without typing.
passkeys.removeText: {name} won't sign you in after this. The password keeps working.
passkeys.nameHint: So you recognise the device in the list later.
passkeys.unavailableTitle: No passkey can be added here
passkeys.unavailable: Browsers tie a passkey to a domain name with a trusted certificate. Open CannonCommander under its name over HTTPS, and you can add passkeys here.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.hint: Every device and browser you're signed in on right now.
sessions.othersEnded: All other devices are signed out

tokens.title: API tokens
tokens.hint: Scripts and other programs sign in with an API token, without your password. A token may never do more than you.
tokens.noneHint: Scripts and other programs sign in with one.
tokens.revokeText: Whatever uses {name} won't get in after this.
tokens.nameHint: What the token is for. It shows up later in the list of tokens.
tokens.shownText: Copy the token now. CannonCommander never shows it again, you can only create a new one.

services.title: Sign-in services
services.hint: A sign-in service signs people in over OpenID Connect, and the sign-in page shows its button while it's on.
services.mustTest: It turns on once a test sign-in has worked.
services.removeText: {name} won't sign anyone in after this. Its accounts stay and can still get in another way.
services.pickHint: CannonCommander knows the right settings for the services listed here. Any other service with OpenID Connect goes through Other sign-in service.
services.ownHint: Any service that speaks OpenID Connect. You fill in the scopes and where names and groups come from.
services.searchNone: Nothing matches {query}. Other sign-in service takes any service with OpenID Connect.
services.formHint: Create an application for CannonCommander at {name} and give it the redirect address below. The address, client ID and secret come from there.
services.whoGetsIn: {name} decides who may sign in, for example through its groups.
services.roleHint: Whoever {name} lets in for the first time gets the role {role} here.
services.issuerHint: The service's own address, where it publishes its OpenID details, such as https://id.example.
services.secretKept: Saved. Leave it empty to keep it.
services.redirectHint: Enter this address at the service. It sends you back there after the sign-in.
services.label: Name on the sign-in page
services.unreachable: CannonCommander can't reach {address}. Is the address right, and can the container get there?

reauth.title: Your password, please
reauth.text: You signed in a while ago. Enter your password to go on with the change.

errors.accountOwner: The owner stays an admin, and nobody can block or remove that account.
errors.badRequest: CannonCommander didn't understand that request. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.caInvalid: That doesn't look like a certificate in PEM form.
errors.cancelled: The browser didn't make a passkey.
errors.confirmOff: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out and back in, then try again.
errors.crossSite: That request didn't come from CannonCommander's own page, so it was refused.
errors.forbidden: Your account may not do that.
errors.fromConfig: This sign-in service comes from config.yaml, so you change it there.
errors.internal: Something went wrong inside CannonCommander. The container log says more.
errors.issuerInvalid: That address doesn't look like a sign-in service.
errors.lastWayIn: That's the account's last way in, so it stays.
errors.nameTaken: That name already belongs to another account.
errors.noAccount: There's no account with that name.
errors.noSignIn: CannonCommander signs nobody in here, so there are no accounts to change.
errors.notFound: That's gone already. Reload the page to see what's there now.
errors.notJSON: CannonCommander didn't understand that request. Please reload the page and try again.
errors.notLocal: This account signs in through a sign-in service, so it has no password here.
errors.notOwner: Only the owner can do that.
errors.notWithToken: An API token can't do that. Sign in with your browser instead.
errors.offline: CannonCommander does not answer right now. Please try again in a moment.
errors.othersSignIn: Other accounts still sign in here, so your password stays.
errors.ownBlock: You can't block your own account.
errors.passkeyRefused: The passkey didn't work. Try again or use your password.
errors.passkeysUnavailable: Passkeys don't work at this address.
errors.passkeyUnknown: This passkey can't sign you in here.
errors.passwordSet: This account has a password already.
errors.passwordShort: The new password needs at least {min} characters.
errors.passwordsOff: Passwords are off in config.yaml, so nobody signs in with one or sets one here.
errors.resetRefused: That code is wrong or has run out.
errors.secretAgain: The address or the client changed, so enter the client secret again.
errors.serviceOff: That sign-in service is switched off.
errors.serviceUnknown: CannonCommander doesn't know that sign-in service.
errors.serviceUnreachable: CannonCommander can't reach the sign-in service right now.
errors.serviceUntested: It turns on once a test sign-in has worked.
errors.setPasswordFirst: This needs a password of your own first.
errors.setupExpired: The setup took too long. Please start it again.
errors.signInAgain: This change needs a fresh sign-in. Sign out and back in, then try again.
errors.stepExpired: That took a little too long. Please sign in again.
errors.throttled: Too many tries. Try again in {retry} seconds.
errors.wrongCode: The code doesn't fit. Take a fresh one from your app.

arrived.addressMissing: CannonCommander doesn't know its own address yet, so the sign-in service can't send you back. Set http.externalUrl in config.yaml.
arrived.flowExpired: The sign-in took too long. Please try again.
arrived.identityTaken: This person at the sign-in service already belongs to another account.
arrived.linked: The sign-in service is linked to your account.
arrived.nameMissing: The sign-in service sent no name.
arrived.nameTaken: That name already belongs to another account here.
arrived.noAccount: There's no account here for that person yet.
arrived.notAdmitted: The sign-in service knows you, but none of your groups there may use CannonCommander.
arrived.renewNeeded: Your sign-in at the service has run out. Please sign in again.
arrived.serviceOff: That sign-in service is switched off.
arrived.serviceRefused: The sign-in service didn't confirm the sign-in.
arrived.serviceUnknown: CannonCommander doesn't know that sign-in service.
arrived.serviceUnreachable: The sign-in service couldn't be reached.
arrived.testOk: The test sign-in worked, and the service is on the sign-in page.
arrived.throttled: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
